notices.text: Hayeon changed her name to 애기😘.

messages.en: What are you doing!
I'm on my schedule.
I left the laundry running at the dorm and came out,
so I'm anxious.
And yesterday,
I had so much fun at the Chonnam National University festival.
Festivals are always fun.
The concert is really not far away now.
This is driving me crazy.
We practiced late into the night yesterday too,
and I'm so nervous.

messages.ko: 나 지금 너무 힘들어 응원 해줘ㅠㅠㅠ
messages.en: I'm having such a hard time right now. Cheer me onㅠㅠㅠ
Why are you having a hard timeㅠㅠ
I hope I can be a source of comfort for you.

messages.ko: 이 사진을 본 사람은 모두 행복해지고 고민과 걱정은 다 사라질것입니다(진짜임)
messages.en: Everyone who sees this photo will become happy and all their worries and concerns will disappear (for real).
I'll give you a good-luck charm.

messages.ko: Y/n는 저 사진 가지고 힘들지 마
messages.en: Y/n, don't have a hard time. Keep that photo with you.
That day,
I left all my contact lenses at home,
so I borrowed Mayu unnie's non-prescription lenses
and couldn't see a thing in front of me.
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
Is that a festival fixed-point shot??
Nope.
I'm starving to death.
I'm going to order something too.
I'll go to the dorm, eat, take out the laundry,
then head back out for my schedule.
A productive day.
Bini said she was surprised to see you eating pasta.
No, all of a sudden,
I was eating risotto at the salon,
and right next to my ear,
she goes, 'Eating something fancy today~?'
and then just walks away ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
This baby has
really mastered the art of teasing now.
Since when did you start calling her a baby? How did that happen?..
Hmm.. I just call her whatever I feel like calling her.

messages.ko: 그럼 나도 애기 할게 그렇게 불러 알았지
messages.en: Then I'll be a baby too. Call me that, okay?
Okay, baby~
Me too, me too.
Baby ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
How many babies are there in here?
You're quite good with words.
I guess the younger generation really is different.
Call me grandpa.
Yes, grandfather. Have you had your meal?
The baby is having their meal right now.
What a hybrid.
They say raw gizzard shad is good right now. Try it.
No, I want to eat it so badly.
ㅠㅠㅠㅠ
Then call me zㅏgiya.
Does that mean i don't have to go to the police station anymore?
ㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 나이가 하연이보다 많아도 하연이가 나한테 '애기'라고 불러줘도 돼?
messages.en: Even if I'm older than you, can you still call me 'baby'?
Of course.
If you're someone I want to take care of, then you're a baby.
Is there any deeper meaning to it~
Hayeon is a baby to us too.
Really?
응ㅇ앵애!!!!!
응ㅇㅇ애ㅐㅐ!!!!!!
I got back to the dorm,
and there are exactly 4 minutes left on the laundry.
Phew.
What am I gonna eat now?
What should the baby eat?
응애
ㅎㅎ아잉
Is something uncomfortable?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
I ran it through a translator,
and it was a direct hit.
Where are you feeling uncomfortable?

messages.ko: 我以为你不看中文消息来着
messages.en: I thought you didn't read Chinese messages.
I run everything through a translator to check it.
No matter what language it is.

messages.ko: Pouvez-vous deviner ce que cela signifie ?
messages.en: Can you guess what this means?
Of course.
Do you know what i love you means?
Me too.

messages.ko: じゃあこれからは日本語で送る〜！
messages.en: Then I'll send messages in Japanese from now on~!
You can do whatever you're comfortable with~~
Because I read everything.

messages.ko: 나도 답장 못한 것도 나중에 다 봐
messages.en: I'll go back and read the ones I couldn't reply to later too.
If you go back and read them slowly later,
the replies are fun to read too.
I want to make you laugh...
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹ You succeeded.
Why do you want to make me laugh? ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 아니 팬도 그렇고 아이돌도 그렇고 왜 웃기려하는거얔ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
messages.en: Why do both fans and idols always try to make each other laughㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Among people who have a desire to be funny,
I've never met a bad person~
For some reason, my desire to be funny is maxed out in front of Hayeon.
I guess I make you that way ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
I'm harder to make laugh than you might think.
Do you read all the letters people write for you too?
Please write me one.
That's my dopamine.

messages.ko: 내 편지 받으면 읽고 감동해서 울텐데 괜찮아?
messages.en: If you get my letter, you'll read it and cry from being touched. Is that okay?
Then you'll get to see me cry.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 편지는 보통 공항에서만 줄 수 있나..?
messages.en: Can you usually only give letters at the airport..?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋㅋ
If you want your letters delivered directly to me,
ah, the company might read them.
They read them all, right?
That's what you're supposed to do~
No, if I only leave this one behind, it'll look even more suspicious.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
I'll just get scolded.
It's mine, so why can't I receive it myself!!!
Am I Hayeon's?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Do you want me to give you that?
I'll think about it.
Playing hard to get.
The baby needs to eat.
And take out the laundry.
Keep fighting today too,
the concert is coming up soon,
so keep getting excited for it~
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋ
I'll go nowㅔ
Haranghae😘😘
